address_mapping.basis: captured_xenos_edram_alias_tiles regression and the frame-622 captured target registers

implementation.renderer: the matching mixed-sample Vulkan executor stores the 4x color attachment, transitions it to shader-read layout, and inserts the Vulkan 1.1 multisample alias transfer before the first 1x guest draw
implementation.format: R16G16B16A16_UNORM linear intermediate; transfer fetches and writes values directly without an intermediate RGBA8 quantization
implementation.scope_guard: only 1280x720, pitch 640/1280, 4x-to-1x, same-base, same-depth-format RGBA8 gamma targets with 720 identity aliases
implementation.fail_closed: the exact transition is rejected if its Vulkan 1.1 alias-transfer shaders are unavailable
implementation.copy_order: guest 1x draws and the captured format-6 Copy/Convert remain after the inserted transfer

covered_regressions: fail-closed behavior when the exact alias-transfer shaders are absent
mixed-sample Copy/Convert and depth resolve controls

verification.current_device_inventory: adb devices -l returned no connected devices

limitations: The available frame-622 presenter and pre-Copy readbacks were produced by the plugin build named in the capture record, before this change; they are not evidence of this transfer's output.
The regression uses synthetic shader/geometry smoke inputs with the captured raster layout. It verifies Vulkan submission, address selection, and fail-closed behavior, not the retail image.
This is a bounded color transfer, not a shared physical EDRAM store. Prior-frame target persistence and general Copy/Convert or format-31 chains remain separate work.
Depth/stencil still uses the provider-confirmed Vulkan SAMPLE_ZERO path; parity with Xenos EDRAM depth/stencil sample addressing is unverified.
The Android ARM64 artifact was compiled only. ADB found no device, so Mali execution and a game replay were not performed.
